question.text: Portfolio has 50% Market (σm = 20%) + 50% Risk-free. Portfolio σ is:

explanation.text: The Logic: σp = w_m × σm (because risk-free has σ = 0 and cov with market = 0). σp = 0.5 × 20% = 10%. The Trap: Not a weighted average of individual σs when one is zero with zero cov — it simplifies. Cross-Exam Context: CML arithmetic. Manager's Pro-Tip: This linear relation makes CML a straight line — not generally true for two risky assets.
